title: Music › Songs row player: harden the lazy/loaded swap and its test (RF-197 review follow-ups)
acceptance: The one-start guarantee is structural, not timing: while a preview row is open, Dashboard keeps whichever player that preview started with, so a later preload (idle callback, timeout, a CSS dependency in the chunk) cannot remount it.

The RF-197 test catches a preload that lands well after the lazy player mounts (not only within its settle window), and its single-use import gate cannot hang collection or leak into a second test in the file.
A failed preload of the row player chunk is retried, so one transient failure does not leave every later ▶ tap on the lazy path (which plays after the tap, outside the gesture).
